entries.zh:
全平台（macOS / Windows / Android / iOS）

新功能：
- 自建 EdgeNest 服务器的订阅合成一张卡片：最上面是「自动选择（推荐）」，下面是各个节点。点节点即固定使用，再点「自动选择」切回；卡片和连接状态会写明正在使用哪台服务器的哪个节点。
- CDN 节点自动优选：按你当前所在的网络测出最快的 CDN 地址并记住，换网络会重新测；同一网络的手机、电脑和路由器共享测速结果，新连接直接用上好地址。只发送网络类别和每个地址的快慢，发给你自己连接的服务器，可在设置里关闭「匿名分享测速结果」。
- 新增「重新优选 CDN 地址」（设置里，或长按 CDN 节点）和「固定使用」某个地址；固定的地址连不上会自动解除。订阅里同一入口的多个 CDN 地址合并成一行显示。
- 服务器开启低调模式时自动换到 CDN 节点，连接不中断；EdgeNest 订阅每 30 分钟自动更新一次。
- 订阅卡片的「⋮」菜单新增「编辑链接」：服务器换了地址时，可以直接把链接改成域名，不用删了重加。另外，EdgeNest 服务器（1.39 起）会下发备用订阅地址，原链接连不上时自动改用。

连接：
- 自动选择更稳：只有当前节点连不上才自动换，并马上换到其他测过的节点；网络整体断开时不再在节点之间来回切换；换节点时不打断正在进行的连接。
- 发现明显更快（快 150ms 以上、多次测速取中位数、连续两轮）的节点会先问你，可选「稍后」或「别再提醒这个节点」。自建的「自动最快」节点组也改为快 150ms 以上才换。
- 代理内部使用的临时地址缓存时间缩短到 1 秒，断开、重连或切换网络后网页能马上恢复。

优化：
- Hysteria2、TUIC、WireGuard 未连接时显示「连接后测」，不再误报超时；点节点右侧的延迟即可单独测速。
- 小屏手机布局优化：节点名完整显示，分组卡片按钮收进菜单，底部导航不再遮挡内容。
- 内核升级到 sing-box 1.14.4；内置规则更新到 10 月 30 日。

修复：
- 开着 HTTPS 改写规则时，连接一段时间后断开、之后提示「端口被占用」且无法重新连接的问题。

macOS
- 新增「断线保护」（设置里打开）：代理意外断开、重连或后台服务重启时，电脑上的 App 会暂时没网，而不是直接用真实 IP 上网；在 App 里断开连接或关掉开关立即恢复。局域网和其他 VPN 不受影响；重启电脑后不会自动生效。
- 修复连接一段时间后境外网站全部打不开、国内网站正常、换节点也没用的问题（家里路由器下发 IPv6 DNS 时出现）。
- 修复断开连接后所有网站都打不开、或部分网站要等几分钟才能打开的问题（连接和断开时会清理系统 DNS 缓存）。
- 更新后如果旧的后台服务还在运行，会先把它关掉再启动新的，避免占着端口导致连不上。

Windows
- 新增「断线保护」（设置里打开），作用同 macOS：代理意外断开、重连或后台服务重启时暂时断网，不会用真实 IP 上网；断开连接、关掉开关或重启电脑都会恢复。
- 连接和断开时会清理系统 DNS 缓存，断开后网站能马上打开。

Android
- 首次连接后提示开启系统的「屏蔽未使用 VPN 的连接」，防止重连时漏出真实 IP；后台保活提示现在能正常弹出。

iOS
- 新增「断线保护」（设置 → 行为）：代理意外断开或重连时暂时断网，不会用真实 IP 上网；万一完全没网，到「设置 → VPN」关掉 EdgeNest 即可恢复。开着它更新 App 时，会提醒你先断开连接。
- 规则模式下也能看到直连出口的属地信息。
entries.en:
All platforms (macOS / Windows / Android / iOS)

New:
- Subscriptions from your own EdgeNest servers are now one card: "Automatic (recommended)" on top, the nodes below. Tap a node to pin it, tap "Automatic" to go back; the card and the connection status name the server and node in use.
- CDN address auto-pick: finds the fastest CDN address for the network you are on and remembers it, testing again when the network changes; phones, computers and routers on the same network share results so new connections start on a good address. Only the network type and how each address did are sent, to the server you connect to; switch off "Share speed results anonymously" in Settings to stop.
- New "Re-pick CDN addresses" (in Settings, or long-press a CDN node) and "Pin" an address; a pinned address that stops working is released automatically. A subscription entry's several CDN addresses now show as one row.
- When a server enters low-profile mode the app moves to its CDN node without dropping the connection; EdgeNest subscriptions update every 30 minutes.
- The subscription card's "⋮" menu gets "Edit link": when the server's address changes, switch the link to a domain instead of deleting and re-adding. EdgeNest servers (1.39 and later) also hand out a fallback subscription address that is used when the original link stops answering.

Connections:
- A steadier automatic choice: it only moves when the current node stops working, and then moves straight to another tested node; no more switching back and forth when the whole network is down; changing node no longer cuts open connections.
- A clearly faster node (150ms or more, median of several tests, two rounds in a row) is offered first, with "Later" or "Don't remind me about this node". Your own auto-fastest groups also need a 150ms gain now.
- The temporary addresses the proxy hands out are now cached for 1 second, so pages recover right after a disconnect, reconnect or network change.

Improved:
- Hysteria2, TUIC and WireGuard read "after connect" while disconnected instead of a false timeout; tap a node's latency to test it alone.
- Small-screen layout: node names show in full, group card actions moved into a menu, the bottom bar no longer covers the list.
- Core upgraded to sing-box 1.14.4; built-in rules updated to October 30.

Fixes:
- With HTTPS rewrite rules on, the connection could drop after a while and then fail with "port already in use" until a restart.

macOS
- New "Leak protection" (switch it on in Settings): if the proxy drops, is reconnecting or its background service restarts, apps on the computer have no network for that moment instead of going out with your real IP; disconnecting in the app or switching it off restores the network at once. The local network and other VPNs are unaffected; it is not active again after a restart of the computer.
- Fixed every site outside China stopping after being connected for a while (sites in China still worked, switching nodes did not help), seen when the home router hands out an IPv6 DNS server.
- Fixed no site opening, or some sites taking minutes to open, after disconnecting (the system DNS cache is now cleared on connect and disconnect).
- After an update, a background service still running from the old version is stopped before the new one starts, so it can no longer hold the ports.

Windows
- New "Leak protection" (switch it on in Settings), as on macOS: if the proxy drops, is reconnecting or its background service restarts, there is no network for that moment instead of your real IP; disconnecting, switching it off or restarting the computer restores it.
- The system DNS cache is cleared on connect and disconnect, so sites open right after disconnecting.

Android
- After the first connect the app points you to the system "Block connections without VPN" setting, so a reconnect never leaks your real IP; the background keep-alive prompt now appears as intended.

iOS
- New "Leak protection" (Settings → Behavior): if the proxy drops or is reconnecting, the device has no network for that moment instead of going out with its real IP; if the device ever has no network at all, turn EdgeNest off in Settings → VPN. With it on, the update button reminds you to disconnect first.
- Rule mode now shows the direct exit's location too.

entries.zh:
全平台（macOS / Windows / Android / iOS）

修复：
- 修复订阅中以端口段形式提供的 Hysteria2 节点（如 50000-53000）无法连接的问题；已导入的节点无需重新导入订阅即可生效。
- 支持 Hysteria2 链接中的 mport 端口段参数。

规则：
- 内置规则包与国内域名、IP 规则更新到最新版本，首次安装时无法连接规则仓库也能使用较新的规则。

macOS、Windows、Android 与 iOS

本次没有平台专属的改动，内容见「全平台」一节。版本号从本版起简化为两段（1.93），之后的更新只递增构建号。
entries.en:
All platforms (macOS / Windows / Android / iOS)

Fixes:
- Hysteria2 nodes that a subscription provides with a port range (such as 50000-53000) now connect; nodes already imported pick up the fix without re-importing the subscription.
- Hysteria2 links with the mport port-range parameter are now understood.

Rules:
- The bundled rule packs and the China domain and IP sets are updated to the latest release, so a fresh install has recent rules even before it can reach the rules repository.

macOS, Windows, Android and iOS

No platform-specific changes this time; see "All platforms". From this release the version number is shortened to two parts (1.93); later updates only raise the build number.

entries.zh:
全平台（macOS / Windows / Android / iOS）

WireGuard 组网接入：
- 支持导入标准 WireGuard 配置：扫描配置二维码或粘贴 .conf 文本即可生成节点，地址、预共享密钥、保活等参数自动识别。
- 「经隧道网段」的网段始终经隧道访问，与上网出口互不干扰：可以一边用所选节点上网，一边访问组网另一端的设备与服务。
- WireGuard 节点与其他节点一样可选为出口、加入分组，本机的规则分流照常生效。
- 跨设备共享新增「一键加入」：接入自建路由器的组网后，无需手动输入配对码即可加入同步。
- 节点编辑中可查看与调整「经隧道网段」「保活间隔」。

Windows

新增 Windows 桌面端：
- 功能对齐 macOS 版：节点与订阅、规则分流、分组、HTTPS 解密、跨设备共享、网络诊断、WireGuard 组网。
- 隧道由后台服务承担，首次连接时一次授权即可安装，之后开机自启。
- 托盘常驻：关窗不退出，右键可连接 / 断开、切换模式、直接选节点、开关防止熄屏。
- 按进程分流：可对指定程序单独指定走代理还是直连，列表显示各程序图标。
- 剪贴板图片与文件资源管理器里复制的文件，可直接发给其他设备。
- 翻译、Wi-Fi 工具、模拟位置、桌面小组件在 Windows 上不提供。

截图与标注：
- 区域截图：按下快捷键后屏幕定格，拖动框选想要的区域，只有这块进入编辑；双击可取整屏。
- 编辑在独立的窗口里进行，按截图尺寸展开。
- 「选择与移动」：画好的箭头、方框、文字都能选中后拖动、改色、改粗细或删除。
- 文字可调字号，默认字号随截图分辨率自动放大，双击可重新编辑内容。
- 裁剪给出选区尺寸与「应用裁剪」按钮，应用后所见即所得。
- 编辑器内可直接做文字识别、复制图片、另存为。
- 「拼图」：把多张图拼成一张，支持网格、横排、竖排与自由摆放，也可以把图片文件直接拖进来。
- 文字识别在本机完成，不上传任何内容。

修复：
- 修复应用内检查更新不显示结果、无法从应用内升级的问题。
- 修复文字识别导致应用无响应的问题：识别改在后台进行，识别期间不再遮挡桌面，超时会给出提示而不是一直等待。
- 修复「防止熄屏」不生效的问题：此前只阻止系统睡眠，屏幕仍会熄灭。
- 修复规则模式下无法连接的问题。
- 修复按程序分流不生效的问题。
- 修复截图与文字识别的快捷键不响应的问题。
- 修复 HTTPS 解密页始终提示证书尚未生成的问题。
- 修复加密 DNS 查询与 CDN 探测在部分机器上失败的问题。
- 修复「防止熄屏」的定时时长不生效的问题。
- 修复按 Wi-Fi 名称触发的网络自动化规则始终不匹配的问题。
- 修复截图保存位置与设置中显示的路径不一致的问题。
- 修复托盘节点菜单不显示当前节点、切换无效的问题；退出时会按设置询问是否保持代理。

macOS、Android 与 iOS

本次没有平台专属的功能改动，内容见「全平台」一节；另有关于页与帮助页的说明更新。
entries.en:
All platforms (macOS / Windows / Android / iOS)

WireGuard networking:
- Import standard WireGuard configs: scan a config QR code or paste the .conf text to create a node — addresses, preshared key and keepalive are picked up automatically.
- Networks listed under "networks via tunnel" are always reached through the tunnel, independently of the internet exit: browse through the node you picked while still reaching devices and services on the other side of the mesh.
- WireGuard nodes work like any other node — selectable as the exit, usable in groups — and local rule-based routing still applies.
- Cross-device sharing gains one-tap join: once dialled into your own router's mesh, join the sync relay without typing a pairing code.
- The node editor exposes the tunnel networks and keepalive interval.

Windows

New Windows desktop client:
- Matches the macOS feature set: nodes and subscriptions, rule-based routing, groups, HTTPS decryption, cross-device sharing, network diagnostics and WireGuard networking.
- The tunnel runs in a background service, installed with a single authorization on the first connect and started with Windows thereafter.
- Lives in the tray: closing the window does not quit, and a right-click connects or disconnects, switches mode, picks a node, or toggles keep-awake.
- Per-process routing: send a specific program through the proxy or straight out; the list shows each program's icon.
- Clipboard images and files copied in File Explorer can be sent straight to your other devices.
- Translation, the Wi-Fi tools, simulated location and desktop widgets are not part of the Windows build.

Capture and annotation:
- Region capture: the shortcut freezes the screen, you drag out the area you want, and only that goes on. Double-click takes the whole screen.
- Editing happens in its own window, sized to the shot.
- Select-and-move: arrows, boxes and captions can be selected, dragged, recolored, resized or deleted after the fact.
- Captions have their own size, scaled to the shot by default, and double-clicking one reopens it for editing.
- Cropping shows the selection's size and an explicit Apply, after which what you see is what exports.
- Recognize text, copy the image and save-as are available from the editor itself.
- Collage: stitch several images into one in a grid, row, column or free canvas — images can also be dropped in from the desktop.
- Text recognition runs on this machine; nothing is uploaded.

Fixes:
- Checking for updates in the app reports what it found, and updating from inside the app works.
- Text recognition no longer makes the app stop responding: it runs in the background, no longer covers the desktop while it works, and reports a timeout instead of waiting indefinitely.
- Keep-awake actually keeps the display on; it previously only stopped the machine from sleeping.
- Connecting in rule mode works again.
- Per-app routing takes effect.
- The capture and text-recognition shortcuts respond.
- The HTTPS decryption page no longer claims the certificate has not been generated.
- Encrypted DNS lookups and the CDN probe work on machines missing a root certificate.
- The keep-awake duration is honored.
- Network automation rules that match on the Wi-Fi name now trigger.
- Screenshots are saved where the settings row says they are.
- The tray node menu shows and switches the current node, and quitting asks about keeping the proxy when set to do so.

macOS, Android and iOS

No platform-specific changes this time — see the All platforms section above; the About and Help pages were also refreshed.

entries.zh:
汇集近期 Android 端的 Wi-Fi 工具：
- Wi-Fi 分析器：扫描附近无线网络，查看频段、信道与实时信号，支持按名称或 BSSID 搜索，以及收藏与隐藏。
- Wi-Fi 监视：把关注的热点加入监视列表，它们出现时提醒；允许后可在后台按间隔记录出现时间。
- 填写 BSSID 时自动补齐冒号并纠正格式，粘贴不带分隔符、或使用短横线、点号分隔的 BSSID 都会自动整理为标准写法。
其他修复：
- 小组件「本月流量」统计异常偏大的问题已修复：现在跨应用启动持续准确累计（包含应用未打开期间产生的流量）；本次升级会把本月计数清零一次，此后重新开始准确累计。
entries.en:
Brings together the recent Android Wi-Fi tools:
- Wi-Fi analyzer: scan nearby wireless networks and see band, channel and live signal, with search by name or BSSID, plus favorites and hiding.
- Wi-Fi monitoring: add the APs you care about to a watch list and get notified when they appear; once allowed, record sightings on an interval in the background.
- Entering a BSSID now auto-inserts the colons and fixes the format — pasted without separators, or written with dashes or dots, it is tidied into the standard form automatically.
Other fixes:
- Fixed the widget's This Month traffic over-counting: it now accumulates accurately across app launches (including traffic that moved while the app was closed); this update resets the month's counter once, after which counting starts fresh.
entries.seekZh:
无线热点寻源（授权后可用）：
- 已知坐标反查、现场实时测向与多点定位、多目标测向与抬头雷达、地图落点。
- 邻居热点：查询某个已知热点时，顺带列出它周边的一批热点，不额外查询；可按距离档显示各档数量、按 BSSID 或名称筛选，并可收藏、设为新目标继续查或在地图上查看。
entries.seekEn:
Wireless AP locating (available once authorized):
- Known-coordinate lookup, on-site real-time direction finding and multi-point triangulation, multi-target direction finding with a heads-up radar, and map pins.
- Neighbor APs: looking up a known AP now also lists nearby APs returned in the same response — no extra query; view per-distance-band counts, filter by BSSID or name, plus favorite / make-next-target / view-on-map actions.

entries.zh:
- 新增「更新记录」：在 设置 → 关于 中查看每个版本的更新内容，了解产品的变化历史；有新版本时先看更新内容再决定升级。
- 规则数据的「刚更新」标记改为仅在更新后短暂显示，随后自动隐藏，不再长期停留。
- 修复部分网络环境下全新安装时提示「已损坏」、需手动执行命令才能打开的问题（安装包现已随包自带公证票据，装完即用）。
entries.en:
- New Changelog: see what each version changed in Settings → About, and review the update history; when an update is available, read its notes before choosing to upgrade.
- The rule-data "just updated" flag now shows briefly right after a refresh and then hides on its own, instead of lingering.
- Fixed a fresh-install "app is damaged" error on some networks that required a manual command to open (the build now carries its notarization ticket, so it just works after install).

entries.zh:
汇集近期新增的多项能力：
- 网络工具箱：连通性 / DNS 查询 / CDN 探测。
- HTTPS 抓包与改写：本机解密、查看并按规则改写请求与响应。
- 网络自动化：按 Wi-Fi 网络或网络条件自动切换规则，支持强制门户检测。
- 翻译：划词（⇧⌘T）、语音（⇧⌘V）、视频（系统声音）翻译，均在本机运行。
- 截图标注：区域 / 窗口截图的标注编辑器，含拼图、OCR、录屏。
- 规则集在线化：广告拦截与路由规则集改为按需下载并本地加载。
- 跨设备局域网共享：配对码升级为 128 位密钥，文件传输进度 / 取消 / 批量操作。
- 新增可关闭的匿名安装统计：仅随机安装 ID、版本号、平台三项，可在 设置 → 关于 关闭。
entries.en:
Brings together several recently added capabilities:
- Network toolbox: reachability, DNS lookup, and CDN probe.
- HTTPS inspect & rewrite: decrypt, inspect, and rewrite requests and responses locally by rule.
- Network automation: switch rules by Wi-Fi network or network condition, with captive-portal detection.
- Translation: select-text (⇧⌘T), voice (⇧⌘V), and video (system audio), all on-device.
- Screenshot annotation: an editor for region/window captures, with collage, OCR, and screen recording.
- Online rule sets: ad-blocking and routing rule sets are downloaded on demand and loaded locally.
- Cross-device LAN sharing: pairing code upgraded to a 128-bit secret; transfer progress, cancel, and batch actions.
- New optional anonymous install statistics: just a random install ID, version, and platform — switchable off in Settings → About.

entries.zh:
- 设置页新增独立「快捷键」区域，一处查看全部快捷键（含划词与语音翻译热键）。
- 菜单栏新增「翻译」入口，与工具页开关同步。
- 关于页与使用帮助随当前功能刷新：新增网络工具箱、HTTPS 抓包改写、网络自动化等章节。
- iOS：HTTPS 抓包改写、网络工具箱、网络自动化现可在本机使用。
entries.en:
- Settings now has a dedicated Hotkeys area listing every shortcut (including the translation hotkeys).
- New Translate entry in the menu bar, in sync with the Tools tab toggles.
- About and Help refreshed for the current feature set: added Network toolbox, HTTPS inspect-and-rewrite, and Network automation sections.
- iOS: HTTPS inspect-and-rewrite, the network toolbox, and network automation are now usable on device.

entries.zh:
- HTTPS 抓包与改写：证书管理（安装 / 信任 / 移除）与响应改写。
- 网络自动化：macOS 支持按当前 Wi-Fi 网络名匹配规则。
entries.en:
- HTTPS inspect & rewrite: certificate management (install / trust / remove) and response rewriting.
- Network automation: macOS can match rules by the current Wi-Fi network name.

entries.zh:
- 新增应用内自动更新：应用会自动检查新版本，也可在 设置 → 关于 → 检查更新 手动检查；确认后自动下载安装。
- 小组件与出口检测的跨端改进：返回前台时自动校准连接状态与网络出口显示。
entries.en:
- New in-app auto-update: the app checks for new versions automatically, or manually via Settings → About → Check for updates; confirm to download and install.
- Cross-platform widget and egress-console improvements: connection state and exit readings re-sync when returning to the foreground.
